isolation.mode: read-only validation against the current working tree

assertionResults.reason: Inventory cards render as bordered warm cards with 16px radius, a 56x5 stock bar whose fill switches between warning, accent, and success colors, and low-stock cards add both an amber border and warning badge.

references.details: Inventory cards use a warm bordered card with 16px radius, a conditional warning border for low stock, the 56x5 stock bar, and the warning badge.
The stock-bar fill maps to warning, accent, and success colors for low, mid, and healthy inventory states.

assertionResults.reason: The summary strip is a bordered warm card with a 12px radius and highlights the low-stock count in the warning color.

references.details: The summary strip uses glassSurface with a 1px border, 12px radius, and warning-colored low-stock text.

assertionResults.reason: The header action is implemented as a primary pill button with a plus icon and on-primary text.

references.details: The Add Item header action uses borderRadius 999, primary background, plus icon, and on-primary text.

assertionResults.reason: The reports flow uses warm surface colors, but its main filter/report containers still rely on box-shadow and shadow/elevation styling instead of the bordered Cellar Ledger card treatment required by the contract.

references.details: panelStyle uses colors.surface[100] with border radius and padding, but applies boxShadow and omits the expected border.
The shared report-section container uses shadows.sm and elevation instead of the contract's bordered card treatment.
Section accent colors are hardcoded instead of being consistently expressed through the shared Cellar Ledger token set.

assertionResults.reason: The date fields meet the bordered-card requirement, but the screen does not implement PDF/CSV export chips with an active primary-filled, white-text state.

references.details: The From/To date fields use mist-1 backgrounds, 1px borders, and borderRadius.sm, satisfying the date-range field portion of the contract.
Both PDF and CSV chips render with the same neutral background and muted text; no active primary-filled chip state is present.
Export is implemented as a filled PDF button plus a separate download button, not as active/inactive PDF and CSV chips.

assertionResults.reason: The fertilizer-plans screen renders a farm selector pill and bordered warm plan cards with a 5px left strip and the plan/input name as the primary label.

references.details: The farm selector pill uses the warm card background, border, pill radius, primary text, and dropdown chevron.
Each plan card uses colors.surface[100], a 1px border, a 5px stripColor bar, and the plan/input name as the main label.

assertionResults.reason: The screen includes the required farm selector chip and a primary 16px-radius FAB with a white plus.

references.details: The farm selector is a pill-shaped bordered chip with primary text and a dropdown icon.
The FAB uses colors.primary[500], borderRadius.md (16px), and a white plus label.

summary: Reviewed 7 assigned assertions by read-only code review: 5 passed and 2 failed. Failures: VAL-REPORTS-001 (reports panels/sections still use shadow-driven containers instead of bordered Cellar Ledger cards) and VAL-REPORTS-002 (date fields are correct, but the required active PDF/CSV export chips are not implemented).
